_comment: Bridge profiles describe WHERE four routing fields sit inside another app's QR payload.
They never describe what any other field means, and the Bridge never parses one.
IMPORTANT: `verified` records whether the field positions have been confirmed against
real output from the named app. A profile with verified:false is scaffolding. A wrong
index silently routes every record to the wrong team, which is far worse than not
ingesting at all — the failure is invisible until someone builds a picklist on it.
Confirm against a real export before an event, then flip the flag in a PR.

profiles.name: Generic tab-separated
profiles.notes: Fully specified by this project, so there is nothing to confirm. Field order is scout, match number, team, then any number of app-defined columns that Courier carries through untouched.

profiles.name: Generic JSON object
profiles.notes: Fully specified by this project. Any additional keys are carried through untouched. Nested routing fields may be addressed with a dotted path, e.g. "meta.team".

profiles.name: Generic tab-separated, full match keys
profiles.notes: As the generic TSV profile, but the match column carries a full TBA-style key (2027mose_sf1m2) so elimination matches can be ingested.

profiles.name: QRScout (tab-separated) — UNVERIFIED SCAFFOLDING
profiles.notes: PLACEHOLDER. Field indices have NOT been confirmed against real QRScout output and are very likely wrong — QRScout's column order is team-configurable, so there may be no single correct answer. Confirm against an actual export from the specific team's configuration before use.

profiles.name: ScoutingPASS (tab-separated) — UNVERIFIED SCAFFOLDING
profiles.notes: PLACEHOLDER. Field indices have NOT been confirmed against real ScoutingPASS output. ScoutingPASS is configured per team via a JSON config, so column order varies by deployment. Confirm against an actual export before use.
